packageRules.description: The major updates of the SDK packages in one pull request. A change of their types fails the generated checks, and the fix is an edit of the mapping in that pull request. They have no minimum release age, because only their types are used.
The sync workflow updates the SDK packages within their ranges, together with the model data. Renovate only opens the major updates, which also need new peer dependency ranges.
The peer dependency ranges are part of the published package and change only by hand.
Minor and patch updates of dev dependencies merge when CI passes.
